          targetLoanRequest:LoanRequest = LoanRequest.allInstance()->any(o | o.RequestID = requestid), isFound:Boolean = if targetLoanRequest.oclIsUndefined() then false else true endif, newLoanRequest:LoanRequest, isCreated:Boolean = false, isResult:Boolean = isFound
            
            precondition:
          true
            
            postcondition:
          isFound = false implies let newLoanRequest:LoanRequest in newLoanRequest.oclIsNew() and LoanRequest.allInstance()->includes(newLoanRequest) and newLoanRequest.RequestID = requestid and newLoanRequest.Name = name and newLoanRequest.LoanAmount = loanamount and newLoanRequest.LoanPurpose = loanpurpose and newLoanRequest.Income = income and newLoanRequest.PhoneNumber = phonenumber and newLoanRequest.PostalAddress = postaladdress and newLoanRequest.ZipCode = zipcode and newLoanRequest.Email = email and newLoanRequest.WorkReferences = workreferences and newLoanRequest.CreditReferences = creditreferences and newLoanRequest.CheckingAccountNumber = checkingaccountnumber and newLoanRequest.SecurityNumber = securitynumber and isCreated = true and CurrentLoanRequest = newLoanRequest and isResult = true and isFound = true implies CurrentLoanRequest = targetLoanRequest and isResult = true and result = isResult and isFound = true implies CurrentLoanRequest = targetLoanRequest and isResult = true and result = isResult
            
        }
